code-review | Pull requests with line comments, reviews and merge controls in the web interface and the API.
description:
UnitySVC runs the official Forgejo rootless server image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. Forgejo is a self-hosted software forge, a community-run fork of Gitea: Git repositories, issues, pull requests, wikis, releases, a package registry, organizations and teams, and a REST API, in one small server. Its data (SQLite database, repositories, attachments and configuration) is kept in the `forgejo` folder of your home, so it survives stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the generated administrator password. Sign in at `https://<instance>/` with the administrator name (default `owner`; Forgejo reserves `admin`) and password, create a repository, and clone or push it over HTTPS with the same credentials or with an access token. Sign-in and Git work at once; to make Forgejo show the right clone addresses and avatars, enter the instance's address in the Instance address setting once the instance exists. Public self-registration is switched off; the administrator creates other users. Only one HTTP entry is exposed: Git over SSH is not available, so use HTTPS remotes. You can run one Forgejo instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream Forgejo documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

features: Git repositories over HTTPS, with issues, pull requests, wikis and releases
Organizations, teams and access tokens, and a REST API
A package registry and a built-in web code browser
One administrator account created for you; public registration is off
Your data is kept in your home, across stops, restarts and re-enrollment

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: The administrator's email address, used for the account and for avatars. Forgejo sends no mail from this instance. Used only when the administrator is first created.
ADMIN_EMAIL.title: Administrator email

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own. It is the administrator's password only when Forgejo first creates its database: your data lives in your home, so if a database is already there (an earlier enrollment, or a later restart) this value is ignored and the existing password still applies. Change the password in Forgejo's own settings. Save it now: the platform keeps it as a secret and does not show it again.
ADMIN_PASSWORD.title: Administrator password

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: The administrator's user name, created on the first start: lower-case letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. Forgejo reserves some names, including admin, user, org and repo, so those are refused here. It is used only when Forgejo first creates its database: your data lives in your home, so if a database is already there (an earlier enrollment, or a later restart) this value is ignored and the existing users still apply.
ADMIN_USERNAME.title: Administrator name

INTERNAL_TOKEN.description: Generated for this enrollment. Forgejo's own components use it to talk to each other. Keep it; there is no need to enter your own. The platform keeps it as a secret: it is not shown again, and it is not part of the enrollment's instance details.
INTERNAL_TOKEN.title: Internal token

ROOT_URL.description: The address of this instance, for example https://abc123.example.app/ (shown in the enrollment's instance details). Sign-in, the web interface, the API and Git over HTTPS work without it. Forgejo uses it for the clone addresses it shows, avatar and attachment links, links in API answers, Git LFS and web hooks, so replace the placeholder with your instance address after the instance is created, then save; changing it restarts the instance and keeps your data. The placeholder https://instance.invalid/ points nowhere, because the platform needs a value here.
ROOT_URL.title: Instance address (ROOT_URL)

SECRET_KEY.description: Generated for this enrollment. Forgejo encrypts two-factor secrets and similar values in its database with it. Keep it: if you replace it later, or enroll again with a newly generated one, values already encrypted with the old key can no longer be read. Save it now: the platform keeps it as a secret and does not show it again.
SECRET_KEY.title: Secret key
